{{Current events|year=2021|month=05|day=10|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Eleven people are killed and 29 more are wounded as a [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bombing]] struck a bus in [[Zabul Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/10/at-least-11-killed-in-afghanistan-bus-bombing (Al Jazeera)] [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073 (TOLO News)]
***Five members of the [[National Directorate of Security]], the head of the economy directorate of the province, and a manager of the Central Bank branch in [[Logar Province]] are killed in three separate incidents. All involved attacks by unknown gunmen. In a fourth incident in the same province, two civilians are killed and six more are wounded after two mortar shells hit their house on Sunday evening. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-172073 (TOLO News)]
**[[Afghan peace process]]
***In the early hours of Monday, the [[Taliban]] announces a three-day ceasefire to observe the [[Eid-ul-Fitr]] holiday. A Taliban spokesman says that it is for the [[mujahideen]] to provide a peaceful and secure atmosphere to their compatriots. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghan-taliban-declares-three-day-ceasefire-eid-celebration-this-week-spokesman-2021-05-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2021 Jerusalem clashes]]
***[[Palestinian militants|Palestinians groups]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] including [[Hamas]] fire [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|barrages of rockets at Israeli cities and towns]] near the Gaza border, and seven toward Jerusalem, injuring several civilians; [[Israel]] retaliates with airstrikes in Gaza killing twenty including a Hamas leader and nine children. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/05/10/world/middleeast/jerusalem-protests-aqsa-palestinians.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/israeli-police-palestinians-clash-at-jerusalem-holy-site/2021/05/10/956fe53c-b153-11eb-bc96-fdf55de43bef_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2019–2021 Persian Gulf crisis]]
**In the [[Strait of Hormuz]], the [[USCGC Maui (WPB-1304)|USCGC ''Maui'']] fire 30 warning shots at a squadron of 13 Iranian Revolutionary Guard fast-attack craft that were harassing a flotilla of six U.S. Navy warships escorting the guided-missile submarine [[USS Georgia (SSGN-729)|USS ''Georgia'']]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/a-us-coast-guard-ship-fired-30-warning-shots-from-a-machine-gun-during-an-unsafe-encounter-with-iranian-fast-attack-boats/ar-BB1gzXfu?ocid=uxbndlbing (MSN)]
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**Citizens who evacuated from the [[Batken]] [[Batken Region|Region]] due to clashes at the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border]] return to the area for the first time. [https://akipress.com/news:657996:Batken_evacuees_return_home/ (AKIPress)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Chernobyl disaster]]
**Ukrainian scientists report that, for an unknown reason, nuclear reactions have increased in the remains of the Chernobyl power plant. Most areas of containment have shown decreasing radiation, yet an inaccessible room 305/2 radiation counts have doubled over the last 4 years. Radiation levels are high enough to preclude installing sensors. Further complicating matters, fuel containing materials, initially the consistency of lava, are disintegrating into radioactive dust. [https://www.popularmechanics.com/science/energy/a36364988/chernobyl-nuclear-reactions/ (''Popular Mechanics'')] [https://www.sciencemag.org/news/2021/05/nuclear-reactions-reawaken-chernobyl-reactor (''Nature'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] expands their [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] eligibility to people aged 12 years and over. [https://globalnews.ca/news/7848632/alberta-covid-19-vaccine-12-or-older/ (Global News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] authorizes the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine]] for children ages 12–15 years old. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/fda-authorizes-pfizer-coronavirus-vaccine-for-adolescents-12-to-15-years-old/ar-BB1gA3P2 (MSN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tamil Nadu]], [[COVID-19 lockdown in India]]
*****[[Tamil Nadu]] enters a two-week complete lockdown until May 24 amidst a rise in [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.livemint.com/news/india/tamil-nadu-2-week-complete-lockdown-begins-today-11620626619021.html (Livemint)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[Malaysian movement control order]]
****[[Prime Minister of Malaysia|Prime Minister]] [[Muhyiddin Yassin]] announces a new nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|movement control order]] from May 12 until June 7, with additional restrictions due to rising number of the COVID-19 cases. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/05/10/pm-announces-mco-for-whole-of-malaysia-from-thursday/1973135 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] reports a record 9,127 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 403,794. [https://kathmandupost.com/health/2021/05/10/nepal-records-highest-single-day-spike-with-9-127-new-covid-19-cases (''Kathmandu Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports its first cases of the [[Lineage B.1.617]] variant in a woman and her 4-year-old son who have been in state [[quarantine]] since arriving from [[Pakistan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/indian-virus-variant-found-thai-travelers-pakistan-77600026 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] lowers its COVID-19 Alert level to level 3 as [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom|vaccination]]s and lockdown restrictions ease pressure on [[NHS]], which means that the transmission of virus is no longer rising exponentially. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-vaccine-uk-alert-level-b1844864.html (''The Independent'')]
**The [[World Health Organization]] classifies the [[India]]n [[Lineage B.1.617]] variant as "Variant of Concern", which become the fourth variant to be designated as being of global concern after [[Lineage B.1.1.7|B.1.1.7]], [[Lineage B.1.351|B.1.351]], and [[Lineage P.1|P.1]] variants. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/who-designates-india-variant-being-global-concern-2021-05-10/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Colombian protests]]
**[[President of Colombia]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]] orders a mass deployment of troops to the city of [[Cali]] and its surrounding area after 12 days of protests. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/duque-militarizes-cali-and-neighbouring-areas-as-situation-worsens-in-colombia (MercoPress)]
**[[Human Rights Watch]] reports on the use of "horizontal high-speed multiple projectile launchers" meant to fire multiples of tear gas or stun grenades simultaneously. The Executive Director of the Americas Division, José Miguel Vivanco, publishes a corroborating video showing vehicle-mounted weapons being used against protestors reported to be a Venom grenade launcher from [[Combined Systems, Inc.|Combined Systems]]. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/05/10/human-rights-watch-warns-colombian-police-uses-high-tech-projectile-launcher-against-demonstrators (MercoPress)] [https://twitter.com/JMVivancoHRW/status/1390396994804502535 (Twitter)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Dunedin Countdown stabbing]]
**A man stabs and injures four people in a [[Countdown (supermarket)|Countdown]] [[supermarket]] in [[Dunedin]], New Zealand. He has also been injured and is currently hospitalised. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-05-10/four-people-stabbed-in-new-zealand-countdown-including-staff/100128890 (ABC News)]
*A [[Judiciary of France|court]] in [[Paris]] dismisses the complaint of a [[Vietnamese people in France|French Vietnamese]] woman against several manufacturers of the [[Agent Orange]] chemical used by the [[United States Armed Forces|United States military]] during the [[Vietnam War]]. The court rules it to be a [[Sovereignty|sovereign]] case under the [[Federal judiciary of the United States|jurisdiction of the U.S.]] [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/french-court-dismisses-complaint-over-agent-orange-use-in-vietnam-war-4275860.html (''VnExpress'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*Sources in Russia's defense industry report that [[Russia]] will be carrying out three tests of the [[RS-28 Sarmat]] [[hypersonic]] [[ICBM]] during the third quarter of 2021 at the [[Kura Missile Test Range]] in [[Kamchatka Krai]] as part of flight design tests. Two of the tests are expected to test maximum capabilities for the ICBM with a specified range of 18,000 km and speeds of ~Mach 20, prior to final deployment with the armed forces in 2022. [https://tass.com/defense/1286447 (TASS)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Italian Football Federation]] president [[:it:Gabriele Gravina|Gabriele Gravina]] threatens to expel [[Juventus F.C.|Juventus]] from [[Serie A]], the highest tier of the [[Italian football league system]], if the club does not withdraw from the proposed [[European Super League]] before the start of [[2021–22 Serie A|the next season]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/57061939 (BBC)]
